summary: Backend-only iteration 60 verification of the census shovel origination flow through Northena/Targeta/CIF/Solva. Executed offline unit suite (13/13 passed) plus a new live public-URL contract suite (23/23 passed) covering login, POST/GET /api/portal/census/plan, engine evidence, scoop-order parity with Targeta ordered_targets, authZ (analyst 403, anonymous 401), Mongo persistence in targeta_mining_plans + northena_ledger_rows, on-disk ledger and dispatch cursor files, census run cursor state, and overview/latest regressions. No mutations against the live estate were performed (no replan=true, no POST /api/portal/census/run).
critical_code_review_comments: Shovel origination envelope is well-formed: reused_active_plan is idempotent (two consecutive POST /api/portal/census/plan {} returned identical plan_id=plan_80002c62711eb23e and commissioned_run_id=cr-aa33fffba60e), so the 'no duplicate plan, no duplicate commission' invariant holds.

Targeta MiningPlan is fully persisted and correctly referenced: mode=per_run, yield_layer_version=core-only, governing_artifact_ref points at objective_request/census-shovel:RMS with a version snapshot, and ordered_targets are the authoritative source of scoop ordering.

Scoop flattening (discovery -> <source_id>:inflight|:unmeasured, region -> source_refs) reproduces mining_plan.ordered_targets exactly in order; no non-oversized scoop exceeds 1 TiB (1099511627776 bytes).

Northena ledger evidence is coherent: admit + gate rows both present in envelope and in Mongo (northena_ledger_rows), gate row reason == 'targeta_plan_built:plan_80002c62711eb23e', and on-disk JSON files exist under /app/assessment_workspace/phase0/northena_ledger for every row_id.

Terminated plan plan_53927bd32e60e591 tail is well-formed: state=terminated, both scoops banked/REFUSED, ledger tail reason contains 'no_progress_signal:owner_dependency_banked'. Unknown plan id correctly returns 404.
AuthZ boundary is enforced: analyst -> 403, anonymous -> 401 on POST /api/portal/census/plan.

Dispatch cursor for cr-aa33fffba60e carries scoop_plan_id=plan_80002c62711eb23e, scoop_index=0, busy_retry_attempt=1, continues_run_id=cr-399d1b46e9f9, and a numeric not_before, matching the documented pending back-off — pending is expected, not a bug.

Minor test-side note: GET /api/census/latest is auth-gated (returns 401 anonymous, 200 with operator bearer). Not a functional issue; the review-request phrasing implied unauthenticated 200 but the correct behaviour is authenticated 200 — test updated accordingly.
